c.st: Game of Thrones: why hasn’t Westeros had an industrial revolution?
c.x:
For anyone interested in industrial revolutions in fantasy or medieval settings, I'd recommend checking out de Camp's "Lest Darkness Fall" and Twain's "A Connecticut Yankee in King Arthur's Court".

Arcanum: Of Steamworks and Magick Obscura is a pretty great CRPG in that setting as well, with fantastic writing and worldbuilding--even if the vanilla version of the game is somewhat buggy and imbalanced.
